cases.question: How has gross margin moved over the last 8 quarters?
cases.note: The demo question. Must cite every figure.
cases.report_md:
The gross margin was 0.7515 in the quarter ending 2024‑07‑28[[fact:17]]. It fell to a low of 0.6052 in the quarter ending 2025‑04‑27[[fact:20]], then rose to 0.7242 in the quarter ending 2025‑07‑27[[fact:21]] and further increased to 0.7341 in the quarter ending 2025‑10‑26[[fact:22]]. The margin remained near the mid‑70% range thereafter, at 0.7500 in the quarter ending 2026‑01‑25[[fact:23]] and 0.7493 in the quarter ending 2026‑04‑26[[fact:24]]. Overall, margin fell sharply in early 2025 before rebounding and stabilising around the mid‑70% range.
